operator_instruction: For subsequent Full Scale training, reuse the matching Stage 1 100k checkpoint whenever valid to save time.
legacy_checkpoint_rule: Preserve and hash the source; migrate only approved post-100k schedule fields; add an explicit RNG restart boundary at 100k; never label the result uninterrupted-from-zero.
forbidden: reusing a 100k checkpoint from a different caption arm
reusing a checkpoint with mismatched data or overlay
silently changing optimizer or pre-100k schedule semantics
claiming exact uninterrupted equivalence when source RNG state is absent
